existing_bridge.boundary: Only facts already emitted by the current Spring scanner are bridged. A jpa-hibernate persistence id is not a verified Hibernate physical model.

upstream_pin.version_boundary: Hibernate ORM 7.4.15.Final with Jakarta Persistence 3.2 and planned Temurin 21.0.13+9 only; Hibernate 6.x/8.0 beta, other 7.4 patches, XML mappings, provider-specific dialects and unbound Spring Boot profiles are excluded

constructs.invariant: PhysicalNamingStrategy can transform an explicitly annotated logical table name; source annotations alone do not establish the physical table.
CurrentTenantIdentifierResolver selects a tenant identity, not a schema by itself; the provider and connection state must prove the physical schema for each tenant.
An @Id on a getter selects property access; field-only scanning cannot assert the full persistent model.
@EmbeddedId has multiple physical key columns; the legacy single idField is insufficient for an ordered-key claim.

runtime_oracle_plan.toolchain: Verify and install the byte-pinned Temurin 21.0.13+9 artifact in an isolated runner; pin Maven version, plugin versions, full dependency lock/checksums, Hibernate 7.4.15.Final, Jakarta Persistence 3.2 and a relational JDBC dialect/provider before compiling fixtures
steps: Verify annotated Git tag object, resolved commit, six upstream source hashes, JDK artifact digest and Maven dependency graph before compilation.
Materialize each authored Java fixture as a separate Maven module; compile with pinned JDK/Maven and capture compiler diagnostics rather than treating source text as executable evidence.
Boot Hibernate metadata under default and custom PhysicalNamingStrategy configurations; compare logical @Table/@Column names with physical table, column, ordered key and FK metadata.

Bind two explicit tenant identifiers to a pinned MultiTenantConnectionProvider and disposable schema-capable database; inspect the Session tenant and physical connection schema independently. Do not infer a schema from CurrentTenantIdentifierResolver or @Table alone.
Probe property versus field access and @EmbeddedId ordered columns under the exact runtime; preserve unknown or unsupported when legacy Spring scanner facts cannot represent them.
Require T16 independent read, T19 mutation review, T01 contract projection, packed-artifact consumption and T20 isolation before any ORM-jpa-hibernate-02/-03 support or certification claim.

limits: The Java files are hand-authored planning fixtures, not upstream source copies, compiled models or Hibernate runtime evidence.
No JDK or Maven is available on Bob in this scope; no Java compile, dependency restore, SessionFactory boot, JDBC connection, schema or migration oracle was executed.
The existing java-spring legacy bridge remains implemented-draft and requires live verification; this scope does not change the catalog, producer, shared contract or generation handoff.
An explicit @Table is only a logical mapping until the physical naming strategy, dialect and tenant connection configuration are bound and verified.
No independent attestation, target certification, supported ingestion or release gate is exercised here.
